footer.tagline: We find the game. We bring people together.

home.title: Your next game
home.lead: Tournaments, training and open courts. Find an event at your level, with or without a partner.
home.step1Text: Check the time, club, level and available places.
home.step2Text: Find the conditions and registration on the event page.
home.step3Text: Check the organiser’s instructions before you leave.
home.faq1Title: Can I come without a partner?
home.faq1Text: Yes. Check the modality and conditions on the event page.
home.faq2Title: I am a beginner. What should I choose?
home.faq2Text: Choose training or an event at your level. Ask the organiser if you are unsure.
home.faq3Title: What if there are no places left?
home.faq3Text: Check the waitlist on the event page. A waitlist place does not confirm participation.
